description: This file implements the DesiredStateOfWorldPopulator interface for managing and synchronizing the desired state of volume attachments and pods in Kubernetes, including functions for removing deleted pods and adding active pods.

classes.name: desiredStateOfWorldPopulator
classes.description: Struct implementing the DesiredStateOfWorldPopulator interface, managing the synchronization of desired volume states and pod existence.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the populator loop that periodically verifies and updates the desired state of volume attachments and pods.

methods.name: populatorLoopFunc
methods.description: Returns a function that performs the main loop logic for the populator, including removing deleted pods and adding active pods.

methods.name: findAndRemoveDeletedPods
methods.description: Removes pods from the desired state if they no longer exist or do not match the informer data, and updates volume attachability status.

methods.name: findAndAddActivePods
methods.description: Adds active, non-terminated pods to the desired state and processes their volumes.
